title: YUL: Bringing Software Supply Chain Security to Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents choose and declare third-party dependencies on their own. They often declare a stale version that they recall from their training data. A stale dependency exposes the project to known vulnerabilities that the latest release already fixes. We present YUL, a design for coding agent harnesses that ensures that no stale dependencies are ever used. It does so by checking every dependency declaration against the package registry. If a dependency is stale or does not exist, YUL blocks the usage and tells the coding agent which version to use, so the coding agent retries with the fix. We evaluate YUL on 60 tasks across six ecosystems with Claude Code running Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenCode running DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Without YUL, Opus declares a stale version in 29% of runs and DeepSeek in 39%, and both declare a stale version in every GitHub Actions run. With YUL, the coding agents end on the latest release in 93% of stale Opus runs

translated_title: YUL：将软件供应链安全引入编码智能体
translated_abstract: 编码智能体会自主选择并声明第三方依赖。它们往往会声明一个从训练数据中回忆起来的过时版本。过时的依赖会使项目暴露于最新版本已修复的已知漏洞之中。我们提出了 YUL，这是一种针对编码智能体运行环境的设计，可确保永远不会使用过时的依赖。它通过将每一项依赖声明与包注册表进行核对来实现这一点。如果某个依赖已过时或不存在，YUL 会阻止其使用，并告知编码智能体应使用的版本，从而使编码智能体在修复后重试。我们在六个生态系统的 60 个任务上评估了 YUL，使用运行 Claude Opus 5.5 的 Claude Code 以及运行 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 OpenCode。在没有 YUL 的情况下，Opus 在 29% 的运行中声明了过时版本，DeepSeek 为 39%，而且在所有 GitHub Actions 运行中两者均声明了过时版本。使用 YUL 后，编码智能体在 93% 的 Opus 过时运行中最终使用了最新版本。
tldr: YUL 通过让编码智能体在声明依赖时对照包注册表进行校验，阻止过时依赖的使用并引导智能体重试最新版本，从而将软件供应链安全引入编码智能体，使依赖最终落在最新版本的比率提升至 93%。
en_tdlr: YUL brings software supply chain security to coding agents by checking every dependency declaration against the package registry, blocking stale versions, and guiding agents to retry with the latest release, achieving the latest version in 93% of previously stale runs.
